children: Cathie Wood-led ARK Invest made a notable rotation within its technology holdings Wednesday, buying Meta Platforms
ARK purchased 43,091 Meta shares worth about $27.9M across the ARK Innovation ETF
and ARK Next Generation Internet ETF
. At the same time, the firm sold 84,392 Alphabet
shares valued at roughly $27.8M through the same ETFs.

The move comes as Meta shares rallied to their highest level in two months, helped by the launch of its Muse AI assistant and the acquisition of Swedish AI company Stilla.ai, which is expected to support Meta’s push into AI-powered business agents.
Meta launched Muse earlier this week through its Meta Superintelligence Labs. The autonomous personal AI assistant is powered by the Muse Spark 1.3 foundation model.

title: Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest bets on Meta while cutting Alphabet exposure
